newsitem.title: SPAIN: Tabacalera says tax hike won't sap profits.
newsitem.headline: Tabacalera says tax hike won't sap profits.

text.p: The chairman of Spain's Tabacalera said on Tuesday that the summer tax hike on tobacco did not influence the firm's margins.

"Profitability is independent of taxes..in the first nine months of the year the firm has almost the same profit net as in the previous year," said Cesar Alierta, addressing a parliamentary committee.
He said that in 1997 Tabacalera will increase its market share in Virginia, or blond tobacco, by half a point reversing the trend seen in previous years.
Tabacalera raised prices on these brands at the start of December in a long-delayed reaction to a government tax hike in July.
Referring to future results, Alierta said the prospects were "quite favourable".

During the first nine months of the year Tabacalera posted a 4.7 percent rise in pre-tax profit. But sales net of taxes and commissions, hit by the July tax hike, fell 6.3 percent to 238.58 billion pesetas.
